limitations: Qualification is scoped to observed native Linux x64, Docker29.9.3/containerd2.4.2/runc1.5.2, cgroupfs/v2, the pinned image and enforced isolated-only profile. Systemd remains explicitly unsupported.

The c9 kernel evidence proves a memory-cgroup OOM for that owned occurrence; exact deletion/watcher/publication ordering and causes of earlier failures remain unproven. New passing observations do not erase them.

Windows/macOS/ARM/WSL/Desktop containment, restart recovery, independent post-crash supervision, cross-host quotas, arbitrary pack/native executable isolation and actual ChatGPT connector invocation remain unaccepted.
Pinned signed runtime packages and eight source LICENSE/NOTICE files are checked. Full runtime/image/transitive redistribution rights remain unaccepted; external runtimes/images are not bundled.
Original native registration EPERM and c9 pack TypeError remain preserved. The new successful uninstall precondition and qualified runs do not establish the original failure cause.
No full capability acceptance, three-component size acceptance, resource/prompts support or model invocation is claimed.
